UnknownParameters = Dict[str, Any]

    @abc.abstractmethod
    def handle_from_dict(cls, kvs: Dict[Any, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Return the parameters to initialize the class with.
        """
        pass

    @staticmethod
    def handle_to_dict(obj, kvs: Dict[Any, Any]) -> Dict[Any, Any]:
        """
        Return the parameters that will be written to the output dict
        """
        return kvs

    @staticmethod
    def handle_dump(obj) -> Dict[Any, Any]:
        """
        Return the parameters that will be added to the schema dump.
        """
        return {}

    @staticmethod
    def create_init(obj) -> Callable:
        return obj.__init__

    @staticmethod
    def _separate_defined_undefined_kvs(cls, kvs: Dict) -> \
            Tuple[KnownParameters, UnknownParameters]:
        """
        Returns a 2 dictionaries: defined and undefined parameters
        """
        class_fields = fields(cls)
        field_names = [field.name for field in class_fields]
        unknown_given_parameters = {k: v for k, v in kvs.items() if
                                    k not in field_names}
        known_given_parameters = {k: v for k, v in kvs.items() if
                                  k in field_names}
        return known_given_parameters, unknown_given_parameters

    """
    This action raises UndefinedParameterError if it encounters an undefined
    parameter during initialization.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def handle_from_dict(cls, kvs: Dict) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        known, unknown = \
            _UndefinedParameterAction._separate_defined_undefined_kvs(
                cls=cls, kvs=kvs)
        if len(unknown) > 0:
            raise UndefinedParameterError(
                f"Received undefined initialization arguments {unknown}")
        return known

    """
    This action does nothing when it encounters undefined parameters.
    The undefined parameters can not be retrieved after the class has been
    created.

    @staticmethod
    def handle_from_dict(cls, kvs: Dict) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        known_given_parameters, _ = \
            _UndefinedParameterAction._separate_defined_undefined_kvs(
                cls=cls, kvs=kvs)

                catch_all_field=catch_all_field)

                value_to_write = default_value

                value_to_write = unknown
            elif already_parsed:

                                f"same name as catch-all field: " \
                                f"'{catch_all_field.name}': " \

from marshmallow import ValidationError

# Replace with your module path, e.g. from myapp.errors import UndefinedParameterError
from dataclasses_json.undefined import UndefinedParameterError


def test_UndefinedParameterError():
    # 1. String message â how it's raised in undefined.py
    err = UndefinedParameterError("Received undefined initialization arguments {'x': 1}")
    assert isinstance(err, ValidationError)
    assert isinstance(err, Exception)
    assert err.messages == ["Received undefined initialization arguments {'x': 1}"]
    assert err.data is None
    assert err.valid_data is None

    # 2. Explicit constructor arguments are stored unchanged
    err = UndefinedParameterError(
        {"x": ["Invalid value."]},
        field_name="x",
        data={"x": 1},
        valid_data={},
    )
    assert err.messages == {"x": ["Invalid value."]}
    assert err.field_name == "x"
    assert err.data == {"x": 1}
    assert err.valid_data == {}

    # 3. List message is preserved
    assert UndefinedParameterError(["a", "b"]).messages == ["a", "b"]

    # 4. Raisable / catchable as both types
    with pytest.raises(UndefinedParameterError, match="bad input"):
        raise UndefinedParameterError("bad input")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        raise UndefinedParameterError("bad input")

    @dataclasses.dataclass
    class Example:
        a: int
        b: str = "default_b"
        c: Optional[int] = None

        assert obj.a == 2
        assert obj.b == "default_b"

        # parameters; extras are treated as undefined and dropped

        assert obj.c is None

        obj = Example(5, c=7, unknown_kw="ignored")
        assert obj.a == 5
        assert obj.b == "default_b"
        assert obj.c == 7
    finally:
